Dean's Excellence Fellowship
Program Overview
[Registration for the Dean's Excellence Fellowship is now closed]
The Dean’s Excellence Fellowship is a distinguished two-year program that supports undergraduate students in the College of Sciences who are ready to take the next steps in pursuing advanced research experiences under the mentorship of UTRGV faculty.
Designed to cultivate academic excellence and scientific inquiry, the fellowship provides both financial and academic support to help students actively engage in meaningful research, present their findings in professional settings, and become part of a collaborative community of emerging scholars.
Program Benefits
Fellows selected for this program receive a total of $3,500 per academic year, distributed as follows:
Summer Research Support: A $2,500 stipend will be awarded in Summer 2026 and again in Summer 2027 to allow Fellows to conduct full-time research with their faculty mentor.
Conference Travel Funding: Each Fellow will also receive $1,000 to support travel to academic or professional conferences for research presentations. These funds can be split across multiple events or combined for a single trip.
Annual Fellowship Luncheon: Fellows and their mentors will be invited to a yearly luncheon hosted by the Dean (Dr. Macri) and Associate Dean for Research (Dr. Pereira), offering an opportunity for networking, recognition, and cross-disciplinary dialogue.
The fellowship is renewable for a second year contingent upon satisfactory progress. Both the student and faculty mentor will submit annual reports outlining research milestones, academic growth, and plans for continued collaboration.
Eligibility
To be considered for the Dean’s Excellence Fellowship, applicants must:
Be a current undergraduate student majoring in a discipline within the UTRGV College of Sciences
Be available to participate from Summer 2026 through Spring 2028. Priority will be given to students who plan to complete the entirity of the program
Identify and confirm a faculty mentor within the College of Sciences who will supervise a sustained research project over the two-year period
Students selected for this fellowship are expected to demonstrate academic commitment, intellectual curiosity, and the initiative to contribute meaningfully to scientific research at UTRGV.
